stdout:
Build kit for "a funnel for a dashboard"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
Matches the idea. Scaffold it, then replace its content. Keep its layout and spacing.

name:        dashboard-cohort-funnel
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Analytics for sequence and retention questions, pairing two shapes a plain dashboard cannot hold: a staged funnel where each step reads as drop-off against the one before, and a two-axis cohort matrix rendered as a heatmap.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template dashboard-cohort-funnel --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install recharts@"^3.9.2" @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        dashboard-alert-rail
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Always-on analytics with a triage rail: status-colored tiles with sparklines, multi-series time charts over a switchable window, and an independently scrolling alert column that folds into the content when narrow.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template dashboard-alert-rail --type page <path>

name:        dashboard
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Three-band analytics: a row of headline tiles, then charts, then supporting tables, all re-reading from one global filter bar.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template dashboard --type page <path>

Keyword search matched these page templates: dashboard-cohort-funnel (@astryxdesign/core), dashboard (@astryxdesign/core), dashboard-alert-rail (@astryxdesign/core).

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover (top 3 of 5; --verbose for all). Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        ChatToolCalls
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: ChatToolCalls displays tool or function call invocations from an LLM response.

name:        DateRangeInput
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: DateRangeInput lets users select a start and end date from a dual-month calendar popover.

name:        SegmentedControl
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A segmented button group that allows users to make a single selection from a small set of mutually exclusive options.
